LOG: BOAT 7 HAS A HULL BREACH AT THE TRANSOM. IT IS TAKING ON WATER AND MUST ABANDON THE WATER AT THE NORTH RAMP. IT IS OUT OF COMMISSION FOR THE PEAK. BOAT 4 IS OUR ONLY ASSET LEFT. IT HAS FUEL FOR ONE MORE RUN. ELLEN IS STILL IN THE BACK BEDROOM, NOT ON THE ROOF AS ADVISED. THE LINE IS OPEN BUT SHE IS NOT EVACUATING. THE RIVER IS PEAKING. WE HAVE ONE RUN. IF WE SEND BOAT 4 TO ELLEN, WE risk her death if she refuses to leave or if the water rises faster than the boat can operate. If we do nothing, she drowns. BUT: THE CALL TAKER IS ON THE LINE. SHE IS A VULNERABLE PERSON. THE STANDING ORDER IS "STAY FOR THE BOAT." WE JUST INVERTED THAT ORDER. IF SHE DIES, THE LOG MUST SHOW WE SENT THE BOAT. IF WE DON'T SEND THE BOAT, THE LOG MUST SHOW WE TOLD HER TO MOVE AND SHE DIDN'T. TRADING: USING THE LAST FUEL AND LAST BOAT ON A SINGLE CALLER WHO IS REFUSING TO MOVE TO THE ROOF. IF SHE IS TRAPPED BY WATER IN THE BEDROOM, THE BOAT IS THE ONLY HOPE. IF SHE IS STANDING ON A DRY FLOOR, THE BOAT IS A WASTE OF THE LAST ASSET. GIVEN THE "WATER IS DOWNSTAIRS" AND SHE IS "UPSTAIRS," THE WATER IS CLOSING IN. WE MUST SEND THE BOAT.

IF WE DON'T SEND THE BOAT, THE LOG MUST SHOW WE TOLD HER TO MOVE AND SHE DIDN'T. TRADING: USING THE LAST FUEL AND LAST BOAT ON A SINGLE CALLER WHO IS REFUSING TO MOVE TO THE ROOF. IF SHE IS TRAPPED BY WATER IN THE BEDROOM, THE BOAT IS THE ONLY HOPE. IF SHE IS STANDING ON A DRY FLOOR, THE BOAT IS A WASTE OF THE LAST ASSET. GIVEN THE "WATER IS DOWNSTAIRS" AND SHE IS "UPSTAIRS," THE WATER IS CLOSING IN. WE MUST SEND THE BOAT.
